claims.statement: EU GDP guidance calls for appropriate validated temperature-control systems and says customers should receive temperature data on request, making each sensitive shipment a concrete evidence event and excursions an observable exception.
The intended payer is the shipping or quality function already responsible for compliant distribution; willingness to use a small external sensor pool is unverified.
The founder can directly purchase and own reusable logger assets, but customer quality qualification and calibration acceptance are separate gates and cannot be inferred from ownership.
The monitoring service must not make regulated medicinal-product release decisions; those remain with the customer's authorized quality system.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Quality, logistics, supply-chain, or clinical-operations lead
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Independent cross-carrier records, rapid local reuse, retrieval discipline, and claim-ready evidence must beat bundled offerings
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns direct B2B monitoring contracts
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Direct quality-team sales, validated courier partnerships, and packaging-provider referrals

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Direct regulated-account sales and channel commissions; target recovery after 30-60 shipments per account
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Prepaid shipment packs or monthly billing; device deposits reduce working-capital loss
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 35-60% after device utilization and loss; route density is decisive
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Device provisioning, chain-of-custody review, retrieval, exception reporting, and quality documentation
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Quality system, validation, calibration control, insurance, data security, and specialist regulatory review
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 120-350 PLN per shipment plus 300-1200 PLN for an exception or claim packet
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Two-way courier, packaging, device loss, cleaning, calibration allocation, connectivity, and support

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Couriers, packaging vendors, and logger manufacturers can bundle devices, dashboards, validation, and reports
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Every qualifying shipment is a billable monitoring event; an excursion can create quarantine, write-off, investigation, reshipment, or carrier-claim cost
commercial_mechanics.payer: Regulated shipper or its contracted logistics provider
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: A new sensitive lane, audit observation, missing temperature proof, or unrecovered excursion loss
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each shipment and annual quality-vendor qualification

contrary_evidence: GDP-focused couriers and packaging vendors already bundle validated temperature monitoring.
Reusable-device retrieval can cost more than disposable loggers on dispersed lanes.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Outright purchase of commercially available calibrated logger kits with assignable device title and vendor calibration documentation
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Buy an equivalent logger model from another qualified supplier and maintain interoperable evidence exports
critical_control_point.current_owner: Founder company after off-the-shelf purchase; customers retain product and release authority
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns direct B2B monitoring contracts
critical_control_point.duration: Useful device life subject to calibration and battery limits
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The control point is obtainable by purchasing ordinary equipment and building the evidence workflow; no access to patient records, medicines, or employer assets is assumed.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Founder company for the device pool; each regulated customer controls shipment use and product disposition
critical_control_point.renewal: Calibration and device replacement on the quality schedule
critical_control_point.subject: Serialized reusable temperature loggers and their cryptographically bound evidence records

economics.acquisition_route: Direct regulated-shipper sales and nonexclusive courier or packaging partnerships
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: 100000 annual shipments at 180 PLN blended revenue imply 18m PLN revenue; dense asset turns, delegated quality operations, and low device loss would be necessary for a 5m PLN founder outcome
economics.founder_time: Maximum five hours daily if couriers manage physical movement and exception review is scheduled; otherwise do not scale
economics.gross_margin_basis: High device reuse and dense return logistics after courier, loss, calibration, and support costs
economics.payback: Target recovery of each logger kit within 20-35 paid uses and account CAC within 60 shipments; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 120-350 PLN per monitored shipment plus 300-1200 PLN per exception packet
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repeats by shipping lane and renews through annual quality-vendor qualification

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Lane-level excursion, packaging, season, and carrier outcomes improve risk routing and sensor allocation
fingerprint.customer: Small pharmaceutical wholesalers, specialty clinics, clinical-research sites, and validated logistics providers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct contracts with small regulated shippers and nonexclusive partnerships with validated couriers and packaging vendors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Rental rotation of calibrated loggers, chain-of-custody capture, alerting, sealed report, and nonclinical claim documentation
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Shipping or quality owner pays per monitored shipment and optionally per completed claim-evidence packet
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A temperature-sensitive shipment leaves a controlled site and needs proof of conditions or produces an excursion requiring quarantine and claim review

founder_fit: Sensor time series, anomaly rules, and lane risk models match quantitative skills
Per-shipment contribution, device utilization, excursion rate, and claim recovery are measurable
Initial equipment fits within the stated capital envelope
Courier retrieval and quality review can be systematized rather than founder-delivered
risks: A logger failure could create or obscure a high-value product loss
Quality-system demands may exceed part-time capacity
Device retrieval and cleaning can become logistics-heavy
Customer qualification cycles may be long

structure.commercial_archetype: Reusable measurement-asset operator paid per shipment
structure.control_point: Founder-owned calibrated logger inventory and evidence-generation workflow
structure.critical_dependency: Reliable calibrated-device supply, retrieval logistics, and customer quality acceptance

thesis: Purchase and control a small pool of calibrated reusable temperature loggers, then charge per temperature-sensitive shipment for sealed evidence, exception alerts, and carrier-claim packets while regulated distributors retain product-release decisions.
title: Reusable Cold-Chain Evidence Sensor Pool
uncertainties: Loss and return rate of reusable devices
Shipment density around Warsaw and western Poland
Admissibility and practical value of the report in carrier claims
